rationale: The stock is in a persistent post-gap distribution drip: price sits 3.2% below VWAP and below the 9-EMA at 17.9% of the daily range, with five consecutive flat-to-red 1-minute closes (12.43→12.35) and zero bounce attempts on 4.56x relative volume, so the path of least resistance is continued drift toward the $12.03 session low. Entry quality near the lows caps conviction, so sizing is modest (8% of buying power ≈ $110 risk on a stop above the micro-consolidation/9-EMA at $12.51) against a first target at the session-low retest ($12.06, ~1.6R), keeping risk well inside the $465 remaining loss budget. A long has no mechanical support — no reclaim of VWAP, no absorption candle — so it is not taken.
